$comment: One fixed subject for each image domain, so that the previews compare styles and not scenes. No real persons, no brands. 'suffix' is added to each prompt of the domain. 'drop' removes primer words that make the model draw text or frames that do not belong on the page. A style override changes the subject or the frame only where the domain subject cannot show the style. A style override can also give 'drop' for primer words of that style only.

photography.subject: a corner of a small-town street with a parked car, plain house fronts with windows and doors, a bare brick wall, and one person who walks past
photography.suffix: no readable text, no signs, no logos, no watermark

film.subject: a still frame from a film: two people talk across a kitchen table at night, with a window behind them
film.suffix: a clean frame with no on-screen text, no captions, no titles, no interface, no logos, no timestamp, no timecode, no digits
film.frame: a still frame from a film,

painting.subject: a small harbour with fishing boats, a stone quay, a row of houses and one figure on the quay
painting.suffix: the painted surface fills the whole image edge to edge, no picture frame, no wall, no gallery, no easel, no signature text

interior.subject: a living room seen from one corner at eye height, 24 mm lens with the camera at 120 cm, level verticals, two walls in view, a sofa, a low table, a rug, a window on one side and one pendant lamp, nothing cut at the frame edge, no door frame in the foreground, no people

industrial.subject: a product still life of three small objects side by side on one wide low plinth against a seamless backdrop: a table lamp, a vase and a cup and saucer, each object at its true real-world size next to the others, each object standing on the plinth, nothing floats, nothing stacked, no furniture, soft studio light from the left, a three-quarter view at eye height, each object whole and in sharp focus, no room, no people
industrial.suffix: no readable text, no logos, no labels, no packaging

logo.subject: a logo symbol for a fictional coffee roaster: one coffee bean with one curl of steam that rises from its centre crease, on a plain ground, centred, the symbol alone with wide empty margins

icon.subject: a 3 by 3 sheet of nine different app icons, each glyph used once: top row house, envelope, camera; middle row calendar, gear, bell; bottom row magnifying glass, heart, folder; on a plain ground

internet.subject: a wide still-life picture of coffee: coffee beans, one cup of coffee and a coffee roasting drum on the right side, open empty ground on the left

architecture-elevation.subject: a straight frontal elevation photograph of a freestanding public building on a wide empty city square: the camera stands on the central axis and faces the main facade square on, one-point view, the facade is parallel to the image plane, all verticals and horizontals level, the whole building in the frame with open plain sky above it and at both sides, no neighbouring buildings, nothing at the left and right edges of the image but sky and paving, no trees, no people
